digest.headline: Platform and AI tooling, week 39
digest.intro: Three releases worth a look this week.

items.title: Nettlefold Registry adds artifact signing
items.summary: Nettlefold Registry adds built-in artifact signing. Signatures are checked on pull, and unsigned images can be blocked by policy.
items.whyItMatters: Unsigned images can be kept out of production.

items.title: Ellerby Operator needs a newer Kubernetes
items.summary: Ellerby Operator 1.6 now requires Kubernetes 1.29 or newer. Older clusters can stay on release 1.5, which gets fixes until the end of the year.
items.whyItMatters: Older clusters have a path that needs no upgrade.

items.title: Quillon Evals adds shared datasets
items.summary: Quillon Evals adds shared datasets that several projects can read. Datasets are versioned, and a run records which version it used.
items.whyItMatters: Eval results can be compared across projects.

sources.title: Nettlefold Registry adds artifact signing
sources.summary: Nettlefold Registry adds built-in artifact signing. Signatures are checked on pull, and unsigned images can be blocked by policy. Keys can be stored in an external key manager.

sources.title: Ellerby Operator needs a newer Kubernetes
sources.summary: Ellerby Operator 1.6 now requires Kubernetes 1.28 or newer. Older clusters can stay on release 1.5, which gets fixes until the end of the year. The operator adds a status field to show reconcile errors.

sources.title: Quillon Evals adds shared datasets
sources.summary: Quillon Evals adds shared datasets that several projects can read. Datasets are versioned, and a run records which version it used. Access is controlled per dataset.
